summary: Tencent Music Entertainment Group filed a Form 6-K with two exhibits: a press release scheduling its third quarter 2026 results release for before U.S. market open on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, and a Hong Kong Exchange notice stating the board will meet and vote on unaudited results for the three months ended September 30, 2026 on Monday, November 16, 2026. The filing contains no transactional terms, no third-party bid, no shareholder solicitation, and no structural change. It is a routine earnings-calendar disclosure with a management webinar, carrying no deal or event-driven angle to trade.
